actionable_improvement: trusted docs.yml evidence across 12 successful completed runs from 2026-10-03T19:53Z to 23:39Z shows repeat avoidable rebuilds after successful CAO Dashboard completions on the same SHA. Queue median/p90 stayed 0s/0s; full-workflow median/p90 was 50s/75s; build-job median/p90 42.5s/50s; deploy-job median/p90 16.5s/20s on the 4 runs that deployed; and schedule-freshness median/p90 6s/6s on the 4 scheduled runs. Trusted step evidence showed Restore node_modules succeeded in every docs build while Install dependencies and Save node_modules were skipped in all 12; Restore cached CAO Dashboard also succeeded in every docs build with Find latest CAO Dashboard run and Mount latest CAO Dashboard artifact skipped in all 12, confirming the docs consumer is already fully cached. Despite that, docs still rebuilt immediately after successful dashboard runs on unchanged source: workflow_run 37162152527 followed schedule deploy 37162438211 on the same SHA 212e6267abf74369c7deb3987077db4300bf59eb, workflow_run 37158661126 followed schedule deploy 37159365088 on the same SHA 12c27ae32a41508fa81572b6783b85a03ccf2e8a, and workflow_run 37150920619 followed schedule deploy 37151943827 on the same SHA 50d47f91cad8b34eefc5662d8e397e20a91239a3. The matched workflow_run executions add 48s, 52s, and 46s of full workflow time respectively, or 146s total / 48.7s average avoidable cost per duplicate. Recent successful cao-dashboard.yml producer runs 37161913366, 37158468282, 37154616442, 37152803777, 37150718512, and 37149744933 also show producer build median 181.5s with Upgrade fallback activity data dominating at 135s median/p90 138s, while the docs consumer remains mostly idle cache reuse. Adding the same freshness gate used for schedule runs to workflow_run invocations, so docs skips when the latest successful deploy already covers the current default-branch SHA and newer-or-equal dashboard run, is expected to remove these duplicate workflow_run builds without weakening freshness. This would save about 49s per duplicate and 146s across the three observed same-SHA duplicates in this 4-hour window, comfortably above the 60s threshold and roughly 97% of one median docs run. Relevant source locations are .github/workflows/docs.yml schedule-freshness and build.if, plus .github/workflows/cao-dashboard.yml triggers that currently fan into docs workflow_run.
